body.input: Which AI companies opened an office in Finland in 2026?

response.content:
Based on available information, the following AI-related companies have announced new offices or significant facilities in Finland in 2026:

- **Cerebras Systems** — Announced a new 165 MW AI data centre in Mikkeli, Finland, developed in partnership with Compute Nordic Finland. Construction on the initial 50 MW phase is already under way.

- **Volta** (an a16z portfolio company) — Is building AI factory campuses across Finland on NVIDIA's DSX architecture, with active hiring for senior delivery roles based in Helsinki.

- **Proekspert** — The Estonian custom software and AI-focused company opened its first international branch in Finland to strengthen connections with Finnish customers.

- **ELLIS Institute Finland** — Launched as a new AI research institute in Finland, with its hub officially opened in 2026, bringing together leading AI researchers and principal investigators.

- **LUMI AI Factory** — Opened its hub in Finland, providing supercomputing infrastructure and AI expertise to support European AI innovation, based in Espoo.

These represent a mix of AI infrastructure investments (data centres and compute campuses), AI research institutes, and software/services companies expanding into the Finnish market during 2026.

context.content:
About The Role

Volta is building AI factory campuses across Finland, each on NVIDIA’s DSX architecture and part of a gigawatt-scale contracted power pipeline across Europe and North America. The Delivery Director is responsible for standing up all of Volta’s sites across Finland and leading their delivery end to end: from preconstruction handover through design, engineering, procurement and construction to campuses that are commissioned and ready for turn-up.

You will be Volta’s delivery lead in Finland. You will stand up every site in the country and lead it end to end, building each one from the ground up: the site teams, the design partners and contractors, the delivery playbook and the governance that runs it, and the standards every campus is built to. [...] Volta is at the start of its build in Finland, so this is a senior seat with real ownership. You will work with Volta’s Design and Engineering, Procurement, Project Controls and DC Operations functions, and you will give the business a clear line of sight on progress, risk and cost across every campus in Finland.

What You Will Be Doing

• Lead end to end delivery of Volta’s campuses across Finland, from preconstruction handover through to commissioning and handover, across multiple concurrent builds

• Stand up every site in Finland: site mobilisation, the delivery team, the partner base and the governance to run it

• Build and lead the site delivery teams: the Construction TPMs and project engineering disciplines for every campus [...] PortfolioTeam

 The new facility in Finland is Proekspert’s first international expansion. Photo: Pixabay

Proekspert opened recently its first branch outside Estonia. The new company strengthens the Estonian custom software and service company’s connection with its Finnish customers. [...] “While extending our reach to Finland, we are more equipped than ever to provide our clients with comprehensive support for their product development journey.
